scope: Public Puff/Huff representation conversion, not an inflate completeness rule
observed: Four-9-bit-literal 88-bit and five-9-bit-literal 96-bit legal raw streams; all independent zlib controls accepted. Padding values that set bits 5 or 6 overwrite metadata TYPE.
metadata_layout: FINAL bit7, TYPE bits5..6, SKIP bits0..4
recommended_supported_boundary: Stored boundary padding values 0..31 are representable, including when the raw alignment field has 6 or 7 bits. Values >=32 must be refused as InvalidPuffinStream before publishing metadata if retaining this one-byte metadata format.
aosp_source_behavior: Pinned 56246e65146cbf7b736343c95a3e8ed970b9d106 source uses the same unmasked OR in puffer.cc and TYPE/SKIP extraction in huffer.cc. No executable AOSP comparison was performed.
offset_note: A stored header is 3 bits: start residue6 gives 7 padding bits; start residue7 gives 6 padding bits. Start residue5 would align immediately.
huff_failure_artifacts: The public Huff API frees output on error, so failed cases preserve stderr and returncode rather than a fabricated output file. Padding32 additionally has a 56-bit misinterpreted Huff output.
